entries.why: APPENDED, NOT SUBSTITUTED — #590: the domain move. The app lives on theharvest.app only; a ministry subdomain serves its Storefront at the root plus its public pages, and the Storefront address can be renamed (storefront_handles → tenant) from the Storefront editor and Settings. The subdomain hop after sign-in and payment is gone, so a paid admin stays on theharvest.app like a Free one, the confirmation says no second sign-in comes, and checkout and claim links return to theharvest.app. Expectations that pinned the hop carry WAS notes.
